title: FEATURE — wire QC gates into batch-produce.ts (reject before ledger write)
rationale: qc-agent.ts (Sprint TICKET-009-Q01-03) built has_real_clip + has_audio gate checks but was not wired into the production pipeline. batch-produce.ts writes all results to the publish ledger without QC checks. Wire runQCGates() after runPipeline() — if QC fails, skip ledger write and log the rejection. Prevents silent/empty videos from reaching the publish queue.
success_criteria: QC gate runs after every pipeline run
Videos failing has_real_clip or has_audio are NOT written to ledger

tasks.description: batch-produce.ts: import runQCGates, check after runPipeline, skip ledger write on QC FAIL
